content: In the year 2157, as the Earth's atmosphere hummed with the static of advanced technology and the stars shimmered with the promise of uncharted territories, Lieutenant Elara Myles stood atop the towering spire of the Orbital Command Center, her eyes fixed on the distant anomaly that threatened to unravel the delicate fabric of the known universe.
